checked_routes.result: GANMA! identifies Kyatapi Land by creator Kyata and links the creator's X account, but the visible work metadata/episode list does not name the four exact campaign identities.

The official GANMA! store route confirms the Kyatapi Land collected editions, but the accessible book listing does not identify the four campaign members or prove they all belong to that title.
